task: Generate four receipt-field answers and a corresponding annotated image from a real scanned receipt, with source-held-out learned field selection and targeted region refinement

selection.group: Uppercase ASCII alphanumeric normalized annotated company, first row per new group; all three sets and previous study disjoint at this level

refined_OCR.region: Selected base candidate bounding box padded by max(6 pixels, 15 percent height); no reference box

decoder.architecture: One shared two-layer tanh score regressor over frozen lexical/layout features and field indicators
decoder.loss: Per-document/per-observed-field balanced MSE to 0.5 exact match + 0.5 normalized edit similarity; missing references masked
decoder.inference: Highest predicted quality candidate for each field; for refinement keep original if its predicted score is no lower

gate_rule: Refine a field if its predicted quality is below the validation-selected threshold; each refinement is a real additional OCR call
fit_gate_objective: Validation mean per-document observed-field (0.5 exact match + 0.5 normalized edit similarity) minus 0.01 times process+child CPU seconds, lower-threshold tie break
confidence_intervals: 95 percent paired merchant-cluster bootstrap, 4000 resamples, seed2712; repetitions averaged within source
acceptance: Over all-refine: lower CPU and wall CI upper differences below0 and utility-quality CI lower difference >=-0.02; over learned-base: positive cost-adjusted quality-return CI lower difference; report exact field accuracy separately
scope: Trainable bounded structured-text decoder over actual OCR evidence, paired image/text generation and compute control; no general visual reasoning, full multimodal LLM or natural speech/video synthesis claim
stopping_rule: One fixed split, fitting and validation; all held-out arms retained with no post-test retuning
missing_reference_policy: None or empty reference fields are unobserved; exclude them from training and per-document scoring denominators, report observed counts. Four-field exact-document success requires all four labels observed and all four correct.
